requirements: All sources/recipe refs are file inputs. Protocol added automatically as live input.
No same-scope links to unselected keys. Predecessors must be ordered and validity supported. Navigation target must exist.
Exactly two semantic reference identities required minimum; format validates shape, semantic truth requires actual decisions.
Prepare verifies Git blob and SHA256 every captured source; input native versions are kernel ids distinct from transport hashes.
All reference files must exist under source root at exact path even if commit reference points to external history. The reference commit verification is delegated to capture evidence.
No source >256000 bytes; native package/body/reference max default 8MiB, observer still 256000 on file inputs.
Prepare creates isolated .atlas/cas only, no publication or policy.
Publish rederives candidate at same absolute root and runtime implementation before binding. No input/transport mutation after prepare.
Binding exact 2 reviewers and decisions, each includes all candidate criteria (with runtime-import-binding), entry results/inputs ids and separate original request+response refs.
Governed publication needs actual actor+scope policy and nominal ratifier where required; no authority created in this preflight.
Use real ownership index/read via script. Query index = scope/need only; read = scope+(need OR key)+maxBytes; optional section,historical true.
No Git checkout has been created; source capture verification only. No Git membership or trust claims from materialization.
Runtime build materialized src only; bun typecheck on adapter succeeded, not full repo/package gate or product test.
